newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares flat, held back by Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares flat, held back by Ericsson.

text.p: Swedish shares were flat at midday Wednesday, depressed by losses in market heavyweight Ericsson but taking some cheer from strength in other European markets.
The Stockholm general index was unchanged at 3,000.57 in light turnover of 1.22 billion crowns.
"It is dead again and there is nothing really to trade on," said one broker. "Ericsson is under pressure after falling in the U.S. and this is pushing the index down."
Telecoms major Ericsson depressed the whole market, falling three crowns to 301.5 crowns.
Trade was mixed. Drugs major Astra steady at 145.5 crowns after trading higher most of the morning.
Market players said UBS had been an active, heavy buyer of Astra shares for some time, supporting the stock.
Engineer Atlas Copco rose 4.5 to 211.5 crowns. Brokers said the market was more positive to the company after it bought U.S. machinery leasing company Prime Service.
"I think we will see continuing improvements in Atlas Copco's results this year and next year," one broker said.
